# Differences between the 2D and 3D public surfaces that the parity test accepts.
# Line format:  Stem: member text -- why
# Stem is the type name without its 2D/3D suffix, after the test's vocabulary table folds sphere/circle, hinge/revolute,
# fixed/weld, slider/prismatic, rotation/angle, convex hull/polygon, soft ball/soft circle and local frame/local anchor together.
# "*" matches any text. Every entry is an intentional difference: physics that does not apply in the other dimension.

# ---- shapes and terrain that exist in one dimension only
PhysicsWorld: method *Voxel* -- voxel grids are 3D; the 2D counterpart is the tile grid
PhysicsWorld: method *Stamp* -- 3D voxel edits; 2D carves and fills terrain with circles and polygons
PhysicsWorld: method *Tile* -- 2D tile grids; the 3D counterpart is the voxel grid and the tile meshes of streamed terrain
PhysicsWorld: method Carve* -- 2D terrain carving; the 3D equivalent is voxel editing
PhysicsWorld: method Fill* -- 2D terrain filling; the 3D equivalent is voxel editing
PhysicsWorld: method DetachIslands -- 2D terrain islands; the 3D equivalent is DetachVoxelIslands
PhysicsWorld: method DetachVoxelIslands -- 3D voxel islands; the 2D equivalent is DetachIslands
PhysicsWorld: method AddBitmaskTerrain -- carvable bitmask terrain is 2D; 3D uses voxel grids
PhysicsWorld: method StampMask -- carvable bitmask terrain is 2D; 3D uses voxel grids
PhysicsWorld: method AddChain -- chains and segments are 2D curves; the 3D counterparts are meshes and height fields
PhysicsWorld: method CreateChain -- as AddChain
PhysicsWorld: method AddSegment -- as AddChain
PhysicsWorld: method CreateSegment -- as AddChain
PhysicsWorld: method AddMesh -- triangle meshes are 3D; the 2D counterpart is the chain
PhysicsWorld: method CreateMesh -- as AddMesh
PhysicsWorld: method AddPlane -- a half-space in 3D; in 2D a long segment or box does the same
PhysicsWorld: method AddTriangle -- a single double-sided triangle is a 3D surface; 2D polygons cover triangles
PhysicsWorld: method AddCylinder -- cylinders, tapered cylinders and cones are 3D solids of revolution (a 2D cone is the polygon or capsule)
PhysicsWorld: method AddTaperedCylinder -- as AddCylinder
PhysicsWorld: method CreateCylinder -- as AddCylinder
PhysicsWorld: method AddCompound -- a 3D compound shape; a 2D body simply holds several shapes
PhysicsWorld: method CreateCompound -- as AddCompound
PhysicsWorld: method AddStrip -- 2D cloth strips; 3D uses AddCloth
PhysicsWorld: method AddCloth -- 3D cloth; 2D uses AddStrip
PhysicsWorld: method AttachCloth* -- 3D cloth attachments; 2D strips attach through their definition
PhysicsWorld: method RemoveClothLink -- as AttachCloth
PhysicsWorld: property ClothLinkCount -- as AttachCloth
PhysicsWorld: method AddSeam -- 3D cloth seams
PhysicsWorld: method AddBalloon -- 2D soft-body presets; 3D soft bodies are built from tetrahedral meshes
PhysicsWorld: method AddBlob -- as AddBalloon
PhysicsWorld: method AddCar -- 2D side-view vehicle presets; 3D vehicles are built from VehicleDef
PhysicsWorld: method AddKart -- as AddCar
PhysicsWorld: method AddTruck -- as AddCar
PhysicsWorld: method AddCharacterJoint -- 3D ragdoll swing-twist joint; a 2D ragdoll joint is a limited revolute
PhysicsWorld: method NadalLimit -- 3D wheel-rail flange climb limit; a 2D side view has no flange

# ---- bodies, shapes, joints
Body: method Carve* -- 2D terrain editing on a body; the 3D equivalent is voxel editing on its shape
Body: method Fill* -- as Carve
Body: method DetachIslands -- as Carve
Body: property Voxels -- 3D voxel grid of a body
Shape: method *Voxel* -- 3D voxel editing on a shape
Shape: method DetachIslands -- as above
Shape: method DigCircle -- as above
Shape: method FillCircle -- as above
Shape: method StampBox -- as above
BodyDef: property InertiaAngleOverride -- 3D has a rotation of the inertia frame; a planar inertia is one number
Joint: method SetAxis -- 2D prismatic and wheel axis; 3D joints take a frame
Joint: method SetPoseDrive -- 3D pose drive of swing-twist and six-DOF joints
Joint: method ClearPoseDrive -- as SetPoseDrive
Joint: method SetSwingTwistLimits -- swing and twist exist only in 3D
Joint: property HalfConeAngle -- swing and twist exist only in 3D
Joint: property IsPoseDriven -- as SetPoseDrive
Joint: property PoseDriveTarget -- as SetPoseDrive
JointType: field Cone -- 3D rotational joint kinds
JointType: field SwingTwist -- as Cone
JointType: field SixDof -- as Cone
JointType: field Point -- as Cone
JointType: field Configurable -- the 2D name for what 3D calls SixDof
JointAxes: field * -- 3D has three rotation axes and a third translation axis
ConfigurableJointDef: type only in 2D -- the 2D name for what 3D calls SixDofJointDef
JointAxisSettings: type only in 2D -- as ConfigurableJointDef
ConeJoint*: type only in 3D -- cone, swing-twist, six-DOF and point joints constrain rotation about up to three axes; 2D has one
SwingTwistJoint*: type only in 3D -- as ConeJoint
SixDofJoint*: type only in 3D -- as ConeJoint
PointJoint*: type only in 3D -- as ConeJoint
JointFrame: type only in 3D -- 3D joints attach by frame (point and rotation); 2D by anchor
PathAngle: type only in 3D -- 3D path joints orient the body along the path
*JointDef: property LocalAnchor* -- 2D joints attach by an anchor point (3D by a frame)
*JointDef: property LocalAxis* -- 2D axis of a prismatic or wheel joint; 3D joints take a frame
*JointDef: property ReferenceAngle -- 2D relative angle at rest; 3D reads it from the frames
*JointDef: property Angle -- 3D path joint orientation
*JointDef: property Up -- 3D path joint orientation
*JointDef: property AlignTangent -- 2D path joint option
*JointDef: property Length -- 2D pulley rope length (3D reads it from the anchors)

# ---- queries, events, options
Material: field DefaultRollingResistance -- 3D default of 0.003; the 2D default is 0
DeformableHit: property ParticleC -- 3D hits are triangles with three particles; 2D hits are edges with two
Buoyancy: method ComputeSubmergedArea -- 2D reports area; 3D reports volume (Submerged)
Buoyancy: method Submerged -- as above
SubmergedArea: type only in 2D -- 2D reports area; 3D reports volume
SubmergedVolume: type only in 3D -- as SubmergedArea
FractureAsset: method FromPolygon -- 2D fractures polygons; 3D hulls
FractureAsset: method FromHull -- as above
TerrainAnchors: type only in 2D -- 2D terrain anchors; 3D uses VoxelAnchors
VoxelAnchors: type only in 3D -- as TerrainAnchors
TileTileGrid: type only in 2D -- 2D tile grid tile definition
TileMesh: type only in 3D -- streamed 3D terrain meshes
TileVoxelGrid: type only in 3D -- streamed 3D voxel terrain
TileDef: property * -- terrain kinds differ: 2D tile grids, 3D meshes and voxel grids
TileHeightField: property * -- 2D height fields are curves (spacing, before and after heights); 3D are grids of samples
ShallowWater*: property Cells* -- 2D water is one row of cells; 3D is a grid
ShallowWater*: property MinZ -- 3D water grid extent
ShallowWaterDef: property North -- 3D water grid edge
ShallowWaterDef: property South -- as North

# ---- characters, vehicles, ragdolls, articulations, deformables: the dimensions model them differently
Character: property Kind -- 3D characters come in rigid and virtual kinds, and have a configurable up axis
Character: property Up -- as Kind
CharacterDef: property Kind -- as Character
CharacterDef: property RigidHumanoid -- as Character
CharacterDef: property Up -- as Character
CharacterKind: type only in 3D -- as Character
Vehicle: * -- 2D side-view vehicles and 3D wheeled vehicles report different state (pitch against lean and steering)
VehicleDef: property * -- as Vehicle
Wheel*: * -- 3D wheels cast shapes and steer about an axis; 2D wheels cast circles
Tyre*: * -- 3D tyres add a lateral force curve
Track: * -- 2D rails are a side-view surface; 3D tracks have switches, frames and cant
Rail*: * -- 2D rail vehicles are a side view; 3D has bogies, wheelsets and conical treads
Switch: type only in 3D -- as Track
WheelsetState: type only in 3D -- as Rail
AntiRollBarDef: type only in 3D -- roll exists only in 3D
Bicycle*: * -- 2D bicycles are a side view; 3D has steering, lean and a fork
Motorcycle*: * -- as Bicycle
BoatDef: property LateralDrag -- 3D hulls also drag sideways; the 2D hull moves in a plane
BoatFoilDef: property Horizontal -- 3D foils are horizontal or vertical; a 2D foil is one line
TrackedVehicleDef: property * -- 2D tracks are a side view over a wheel list; 3D has left and right wheel lists and lateral friction
Ragdoll*: * -- 2D ragdolls use limited revolute joints, 3D swing-twist joints
ArticulationDef: method * -- named robot presets differ by dimension
ArticulationLinkDef: property * -- planar inertia and angle against a tensor and rotation
ArticulationShape: property * -- planar shape against 3D shape specification
Articulation: method * -- 3D joints take rotation targets
ShapeSpec: type only in 3D -- 3D shape description for articulations and compounds
CompoundPart: type only in 3D -- 3D compound shapes (a 2D body simply holds several shapes)
ThrusterRig: method * -- named rig presets differ by dimension
ThrusterDef: property * -- 3D gimbal axis and spin torque
Pulley*: * -- 3D pulleys and sprockets have a rotation axis
Sprocket: * -- as Pulley
SoftBody*: * -- 2D soft bodies are outline meshes with shape matching and area constraints, 3D are tetrahedral or cloth with volume constraints and skinning
SoftMaterial: field Cloth -- 3D cloth material
SoftSkin: type only in 3D -- 3D skinning
SkinJointPose: type only in 3D -- as SoftSkin
SoftBodyModel: type only in 2D -- 2D soft-body model kinds
StripParams: type only in 2D -- 2D cloth strips
Cloth*: type only in 3D -- 3D cloth; 2D uses strips
WheelCastShape: type only in 3D -- as Wheel
BicyclePart: type only in 3D -- as Bicycle
BicycleWheel: type only in 3D -- as Bicycle
ClothLinkKind: type only in 3D -- as Cloth
ClothMaterial: type only in 3D -- as Cloth
ClothParams: type only in 3D -- as Cloth
